hero.title: Adoptable Pets — GetBuddy
hero.description: GetBuddy's embeddable listings iframe, keyed off an organization ID.

example.title: Example
example.description: Pets shown from the rescue's GetBuddy page. If it can't load, a plain link to the full list stays on the page.

disclosure: Animal Friends of the Valleys (Wildomar, CA) is a real rescue whose public listings are used below to demonstrate this adapter with real-world data. This template and 4leggedIT are not affiliated with Animal Friends of the Valleys.

standard.title: Usage rules
items: Use `mode="getbuddy"` (or the standalone `GetBuddyEmbed`) for a site whose listings are managed on GetBuddy.
`organizationId` is GetBuddy's own org ID — found in the org's GetBuddy shelter page URL.

`species` filters the embed (e.g. `"dog"`); `iframeHeight` sets the embed window's height (default 600px, never more than 80% of the viewport; GetBuddy's embed has no pagination and lists every animal, so this is a scroll window), `showIframe=false` renders link-out only.
`listingsUrl` (optional) is the org's own GetBuddy shelter page — used for the "Or view all pets on GetBuddy" link and as the no-JS fallback destination.
Standard helper line is part of the adapter (`Or view all pets on GetBuddy`) — cross-links to `petfinderUrl`/`adoptAPetUrl`/`pawPlacerUrl` render alongside it automatically when those props are set.
